name: Clarify pre-layer
prose: a genuinely open-ended request ("build a game", "improve this app") triggers up to three shape-defining multiple-choice questions BEFORE any work, judged by the main model; concrete/trivial/follow-up requests never trigger it; fail-open on any error; root attended turns only; `clarify: false` disables.
invariant: The clarify pre-layer runs before the turn when settings.clarify is on.
